blogs.title: Beyond Rhabdo: Recognizing Immune-Mediated Necrotizing Myopathy After GLP-1 Agonists
blogs.description: How to distinguish rhabdomyolysis from IMNM in patients exposed to semaglutide or tirzepatide—timing of symptoms, CK kinetics, lack of rapid improvement after drug cessation, and the implications for biopsy and early immunosuppression.

blogs.title: The Seronegative Trap: Negative Myositis Panels Don’t Rule Out IMNM
blogs.description: One-third of IMNM is seronegative. Practical steps when SRP/HMGCR and myositis panels are negative: MRI-targeted muscle biopsy, what histology to look for, and when to start steroids/IVIG despite negative serologies.

blogs.title: One Dose, Big Problem: Pharmacovigilance Lessons from Semaglutide-Associated IMNM
blogs.description: Applying WHO-UMC causality to rare adverse events, why rechallenge is a bad idea, what to document and report, and building a differential when progressive weakness follows even a single GLP-1 dose.

blogs.title: AST Up, CK Up? Sorting Muscle vs Liver Injury in NAFLD Patients
blogs.description: Clinical pearls to distinguish hepatic from myopathic transaminase elevations: the roles of CK, aldolase, GGT, bilirubin, and timing—plus when to pursue liver versus muscle biopsy in obese patients with baseline NAFLD.

blogs.title: IMNM on Histology: What to Ask Your Pathologist and How to Pick the Right Muscle
blogs.description: Biopsy logistics for suspected IMNM: using MRI STIR to choose the site; expected findings (necrosis/regeneration, CD68+ macrophages, limited lymphocytes, MAC deposition); and requests that improve diagnostic yield.

blogs.title: Hit Early, Hit Hard: Steroids and IVIG for Severe or Bulbar IMNM
blogs.description: A pragmatic approach to initiating pulse methylprednisolone plus IVIG for severe or bulbar involvement: dosing, tapering, monitoring CK and strength, infection mitigation, and when to consider additional agents.

blogs.title: When Myopathy Affects the Heart: Troponin Bumps and Cardiac MRI in Inflammatory Myopathies
blogs.description: Interpreting modest hs-troponin/BNP elevations in myositis, choosing troponin I vs T, when to obtain echo/CMR, distinguishing myocarditis from stress cardiomyopathy, and practical monitoring for arrhythmias.

blogs.title: Weight Loss Drugs, Lean Mass, and Muscle Injury: What Should Clinicians Tell Patients?
blogs.description: Counseling around GLP-1–associated lean mass loss and rare muscle injury: red flags (progressive proximal weakness, dysphagia/dysphonia), when to check CK, when to stop the drug, and referral pathways.
